title: The Slide
content: Dreamt recently of this super high and massive wide highway long stretch like air bounce house like slide that it seemed to go slow going down. The climb up was strenuous because felt like I just got out of the Mall. So the slide seemed to be daytime outside next to futuristic city Not in the amusement park. In the dream the slide ride parts also felt like the some touring view of the city. Parts was impoverished trashy and polluted atmosphere and in the distance the horizon the a giant tree! What made me feel uncomfortable was that as I kept riding down slow felt like it just kept going I vaguely saw 3 people. Scary part of the dream near the end of the tour slide took me to the empty streets and by the Mall entrance. 😮‍💨
